name: Shotgun Metagenomics
overview: 鸟枪法宏基因组测序分析流程，涵盖宿主去除、分类学注释、功能注释和多样本比较。

steps.name: 质控 + 宿主去除
steps.notes: KneadData 先运行 Trimmomatic 去除低质量读段，再用 Bowtie2 比对到宿主参考基因组去除宿主 reads。人类粪便样本宿主去除率通常 80-99%。
steps.notesEn: KneadData runs Trimmomatic for low-quality reads then Bowtie2 against host reference to remove host reads. Human stool sample host removal rate typically 80-99%.

steps.name: 分类学注释
steps.notes: MetaPhlAn 基于 ~100 万 marker gene 数据库，提供种水平分辨率。输出相对丰度表，可进一步用 LEfSe 做差异物种分析。
steps.notesEn: MetaPhlAn uses ~1M marker gene database, provides species-level resolution. Output relative abundance table; use LEfSe for differential species analysis.

steps.name: 功能注释
steps.description: HUMAnN 3 通路/基因家族注释
steps.notes: HUMAnN 将 reads mapping 到 UniRef90 基因家族和 MetaCyc 通路。输出 pathway abundance 表可用于多样本比较。
steps.notesEn: HUMAnN maps reads to UniRef90 gene families and MetaCyc pathways. Output pathway abundance table for multi-sample comparison.

steps.name: 组装 + 分箱（可选）
steps.notes: 深度测序（> 10G per sample）可选从头组装，获取微生物基因组草图（MAGs）。CheckM 评估 MAG 完整性。
steps.notesEn: Deep sequencing (>10G per sample) enables de novo assembly for metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs). CheckM evaluates MAG completeness.

steps.name: 统计分析与可视化
steps.description: Alpha/Beta 多样性 + 差异分析
steps.notes: phyloseq 整合分类、功能和元数据。MaAsLin2 做多变量关联分析。可视化：PCoA、NMDS、堆叠柱状图、热图。
steps.notesEn: phyloseq integrates taxonomy, function, and metadata. MaAsLin2 for multivariate association analysis. Visualization: PCoA, NMDS, stacked bar plots, heatmaps.

references.title: Integrating taxonomic, functional, and strain-level profiling (Beghini et al., 2021)

overviewEn: Shotgun metagenomics analysis pipeline. Covers QC, host removal, taxonomic profiling (MetaPhlAn, Kraken2), functional profiling (HUMAnN), assembly, and binning. Suitable for microbiome community composition and function studies.
